name: Flow-Vol
description: Like eth-volfav (buy the favourite late in the window when the market's implied volatility is high relative to a forecast), but the forecast also uses per-second order flow (Binance spot and OKX perp volume, trade counts, largest trade) so it can tell volatility that is about to fade from volatility that will persist.
hypothesis: Volume and trade intensity lead volatility, and Kalshi's implied vol is anchored on price-based realized vol. Where flow is quiet the market's vol is too high and the favourite is cheap; where flow is hot the HAR-only signal fires falsely. Research (BTC, ETH, SOL walk-forward): flow adds +0.02 OOS R2 and the flow-model top-decile favourite earned +1.0c BTC / +1.6c ETH vs HAR-only; HAR-only-but-not-flow rows lost -1.4c (BTC) and -2.1c (SOL). Wrong if: the full walk-forward CI is not above 0 or the edge is concentrated in <60% of months.
